title.en: New dinosaur species with neck as long as cricket pitch discovered in Thailand
title.zh: 泰国发现新恐龙物种，脖子长如板球场

summary.en: A new plant-eating dinosaur species, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, with a neck as long as a cricket pitch, has been discovered in Thailand. Scientists believe it lived approximately 150 million years ago.
summary.zh: 在泰国发现了一种新的植食性恐龙物种，其脖子与板球场一样长，被命名为乌拉加龙（Uragasaurus kalasinensis）。科学家认为它生活在大约1.5亿年前。

body.en:
Palaeontologists in Thailand say they have discovered a new species of dinosaur from fossils found in Kalasin Province in the country's north-east.

The plant-eating dinosaur, named Uragasaurus kalasinensis, is thought to have lived about 150 million years ago.

It had an unusually long neck and measured up to 20m (66ft) - roughly the length of a cricket pitch.

Dr Apirat Nilphanaphan from Thailand's Mahasarakham University, the study's lead author, told BBC Thai that the specimen was part of a large fossil collection from a site first identified in 2008, when a local man found fragments resembling serpent scales.

The site where the discovery was made, Phu Noi, contained a wide variety of fossils from the Late Jurassic period. More than 90% of the fossils excavated from the site were dinosaur fragments.

When the survey team went to explore the site it found other fossils such as dinosaur teeth and bones.

However, the fossil that led to the discovery of the new species was a recovered dorsal vertebra — a bone from the middle or upper back — which showed distinctive characteristics.

A CT scan revealed that the dinosaur belonged to the Mamenchisauridae family of sauropod dinosaurs, characterised by their extremely long necks, which likely helped them reach vegetation at different heights.

While most fossils from the Mamenchisauridae family have been found in China, this discovery is the first of its kind in Thailand.

The scan also revealed unique characteristics, including a Y-shaped arrangement of supporting bones known as laminae.

Niphanaphan told BBC Thai the features, in particular a unique air-cavity structure, were "unlike any other dinosaur in the world... That's what sets it apart".

He said he smashed his keyboard after realising they had discovered a new species, adding that he felt both "exhilarated and relieved".

In May, it was revealed that a different type of long-necked herbivore dinosaur - the nagatitan - had been identified by scientists from remains dug up in Thailand.

The nagatitan is the largest-ever dinosaur found in South-East Asia, weighing 27 tonnes - as much as nine adult Asian elephants - and measured 27m (88ft) in length.
body.zh: 泰国古生物学家表示，他们从该国东北部加拉信省发现的化石中发现了一种新的恐龙物种。 这种食草恐龙被称为卡拉辛乌拉嘎龙 (Uragasaurus kalasinensis)，被认为生活在大约 1.5 亿年前。 它有一个异常长的脖子，长达 20m（66 英尺）——大约是一个板球场的长度。 该研究的主要作者、泰国玛哈沙拉堪大学的 Apirat Nilphanaphan 博士告诉 BBC Thai，该标本是 2008 年首次发现的一个地点的大型化石收藏的一部分，当时一名当地人发现了类似蛇鳞的碎片。 这一发现的地点 Phu Noi 含有多种侏罗纪晚期的化石。该遗址出土的化石90%以上是恐龙碎片。 当调查小组探索该地点时，他们发现了其他化石，例如恐龙牙齿和骨骼。 然而，导致新物种发现的化石是一块恢复的背椎骨——来自中背部或上背部的骨头——它显示出独特的特征。 CT扫描显示，这只恐龙属于蜥脚类恐龙马门溪龙科，其特点是脖子极长，这可能有助于它们到达不同高度的植被。 虽然马门溪龙科的大部分化石都是在中国发现的，但这一发现在泰国尚属首次。 扫描还揭示了独特的特征，包括 Y 形排列的支撑骨（称为椎板）。 Niphanaphan 告诉 BBC Thai，这些特征，特别是独特的气腔结构，“不同于世界上任何其他恐龙……这就是它的与众不同之处”。 他说，在意识到他们发现了一个新物种后，他摔碎了键盘，并补充说，他感到“兴奋又如释重负”。 今年五月，科学家们从泰国挖掘出的遗骸中发现了另一种不同类型的长颈食草恐龙——纳加泰坦。 纳加泰坦是东南亚有史以来发现的最大的恐龙，重 27 吨，相当于 9 头成年亚洲象，长度为 27 m（88 英尺）。

reflection.en: The discovery of a new dinosaur species reminds us of the incredible diversity and ancient history of life on Earth. As Job 12:7 suggests, creation itself speaks volumes, inviting us to marvel at the intricate and vast works of Yahweh. Such findings deepen our appreciation for the Creator's boundless imagination and power across millennia.
reflection.zh: 新恐龙物种的发现提醒我们地球上生命令人惊叹的多样性和悠久历史。正如约伯记12:7所言，受造物本身就雄辩地诉说着，邀请我们惊叹雅伟奇妙而浩瀚的作为。这些发现加深了我们对造物主跨越千年的无限想象力和能力的敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: John Fetterman joins forces with Republican counterpart in Senate for fundraising committee
title.zh: 约翰·费特曼与共和党参议员联手成立筹款委员会

summary.en: Democratic Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania has partnered with Republican Senator Dave McCormick to launch a new joint fundraising committee, sparking discussion about Fetterman's political alignment.
summary.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州民主党参议员约翰·费特曼与共和党参议员戴夫·麦考密克联手成立了一个新的联合筹款委员会，引发了人们对费特曼政治立场的猜测。

body.en: Venture between two Pennsylvania senators stokes speculation about Fetterman’s future in Democratic party The Democratic senator John Fetterman, who has faced mounting political challenges, is joining forces with the Republican senator Dave McCormick to launch a new joint fundraising committee, a move that is likely to fuel additional questions about Fetterman’s increasingly rightward lurch. Pennsylvania ’s two US senators have established a shared fundraising committee that will collect donations benefiting both of their campaigns in an unusual bipartisan arrangement. Continue reading...
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州两名参议员之间的合作引发了对费特曼在民主党未来的猜测 面临着越来越大的政治挑战的民主党参议员约翰·费特曼正在与共和党参议员戴夫·麦考密克联手成立一个新的联合筹款委员会，此举可能会引发人们对费特曼日益右倾的更多质疑。宾夕法尼亚州的两位美国参议员成立了一个共同筹款委员会，该委员会将通过一项不同寻常的两党安排收集有利于他们竞选活动的捐款。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This unexpected bipartisan venture highlights the potential to bridge political divides, even when it challenges conventional party lines. Just as Yahweh broke down the wall of hostility between groups, such efforts can foster unity and a shared purpose beyond partisan differences.
reflection.zh: 这种出人意料的两党合作凸显了弥合政治分歧的潜力，即使这会挑战传统的党派界限。正如雅伟拆毁了群体之间的敌意之墙，这样的努力也能在超越党派差异的基础上，促进合一和共同目标。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: Rapper Pitbull and fans set ‘bald cap’ Guinness World Record at Hyde Park show
title.zh: 说唱歌手Pitbull和粉丝在海德公园演出中创造“秃头帽”吉尼斯世界纪录

summary.en: Rapper Pitbull and over 22,000 fans gathered at Hyde Park to set a Guinness World Record for the largest assembly of people wearing bald caps, despite warm temperatures. Participants also wore white shirts and black attire for the event.
summary.zh: 说唱歌手Pitbull和超过22,000名粉丝在海德公园聚集，创造了最多人戴“秃头帽”的吉尼斯世界纪录，尽管天气炎热。参与者还穿着白色衬衫和黑色服装参加了此次活动。

body.en: Crowd of over 22,000 people – and the musician himself – formed the ‘largest gathering of people wearing bald caps’ A tight plastic cap is not an attractive option for protective headwear in 30C (86F) heat. Yet 22,141 people opted for just that – along with a white shirt, black tie and aviator sunglasses – in Hyde Park, London, on Friday afternoon. It was both a homage to the rapper Pitbull, the night’s headliner at the BST festival, and part of setting a Guinness World Record for the “largest gathering of people wearing bald caps”. “I’m speechless. Who would have thought a first-generation Cuban would be record-breaking and record-making?” said the rapper, accepting the award in an all-black suit. Continue reading...
body.zh: 超过 22,000 人——以及音乐家本人——形成了“最大的戴秃帽的人群”。在 30 摄氏度（86 华氏度）的高温下，紧身塑料帽并不是一个有吸引力的防护帽选择。然而，周五下午，在伦敦海德公园，有 22,141 人选择了这一点——还有白衬衫、黑领带和飞行员太阳镜。这既是对当晚 BST 音乐节的头条新闻说唱歌手 Pitbull 的致敬，也是创造“最大的戴秃帽人群聚集”吉尼斯世界纪录的一部分。 “我无语了。谁能想到第一代古巴人会打破纪录、创造纪录？”穿着全黑西装领奖的说唱歌手说道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The enthusiasm of thousands gathering to participate in a celebrity-led world record highlights the human desire for connection and shared experience. While such events can be harmless fun, Yahweh's word reminds us to guard our hearts against placing ultimate devotion in anything or anyone other than Him. Our deepest affections and loyalties are best...
reflection.zh: 数千人热情聚集参与由名人主导的世界纪录，这凸显了人类对联结和共同体验的渴望。虽然此类活动可以是无害的乐趣，但雅伟的话语提醒我们，要警惕将最终的忠诚和敬拜放在祂以外的任何人或事上。我们最深切的情感和忠诚，最好是留给那位真正能满足我们的创造主。

verse.textEn: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.
verse.textZh: 小子们哪，你们要自守，远避偶像。

summary.en: Habitat destruction strongest driver of species loss, with legislation keeping 99% of listed species from going extinct The Trump administration repealed a crucial part of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) on Friday, finalizing a new rule that will open habitats of imperiled...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Habitat destruction strongest driver of species loss, with legislation keeping 99% of listed species from going extinct The Trump administration repealed a crucial part of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) on Friday, finalizing a new rule that will open habitats of imperiled wildlife to development, logging, mining and other uses. For the last 50 years, the landmark environmental law included a broader understanding of the word “harm”, which ensured that not just the plants and animals themselves were protected but also the places that are critical to their survival. The inclusion of habitat in the “harm” definition was upheld by the supreme court in 1995, which ruled in support of old-growth forest protections relied on by endangered spotted owls. Continue reading...
body.zh: 栖息地破坏是物种丧失的最大驱动因素，立法使 99% 的列入物种免于灭绝特朗普政府周五废除了《濒危物种法案》(ESA) 的重要部分，最终确定了一项新规则，将开放濒危野生动物的栖息地进行开发、伐木、采矿和其他用途。过去 50 年来，具有里程碑意义的环境法对“伤害”一词有了更广泛的理解，确保不仅动植物本身受到保护，对其生存至关重要的地方也受到保护。 1995年，最高法院维持将栖息地纳入“危害”定义，并作出裁决，支持对濒临灭绝的斑点猫头鹰赖以生存的原始森林进行保护。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to creation care and environmental responsibility. Genesis 2:15 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with faithful stewardship of creation, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到受造之物关怀与环保责任。Genesis 2:15提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以对受造之物的忠心管家来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

body.en: Rule from Mamdani administration bans companies from trapping customers into paying recurring charges and ‘junk fees’ New York City has adopted a new rule that bans companies from using deceptive subscriptions to trap customers into paying for gym memberships, streaming services and other recurring charges, the city’s consumer protection office said. The new rule, which will start on 1 October, promises hefty fines and aggressive enforcement for violators. Companies that do not provide a simple way to cancel could pay $525 per user subscription, back fees and additional fines. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马姆达尼政府的规定禁止公司诱骗客户支付经常性费用和“垃圾费” 纽约市消费者保护办公室表示，纽约市采取了一项新规则，禁止公司使用欺骗性订阅来诱骗客户支付健身房会员资格、流媒体服务和其他经常性费用。新规定将于 10 月 1 日开始实施，承诺对违规者处以巨额罚款并严厉执法。不提供简单取消方式的公司可能需要为每位用户支付 525 美元的订阅费、滞纳金和额外罚款。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: NAACP demands end of Trump’s anticrime taskforce in Memphis after deaths of Black men
title.zh: 全国有色人种协进会要求解散特朗普在孟菲斯的反犯罪专案组，此前有黑人男子死亡

summary.en: The National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP) has called for an end to a federal anticrime task force in Memphis and a thorough, transparent federal investigation following the recent deaths of two Black men in Tennessee, one in police custody and another involving National Guard troops.
summary.zh: 全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）要求解散孟菲斯的一个联邦反犯罪专案组，并呼吁进行彻底透明的联邦调查。此前，田纳西州有两名黑人男子死亡，其中一人在警方拘留期间，另一人死于国民警卫队之手。

body.en: Advocacy group calls on acting attorney general to lead ‘thorough, transparent federal investigation’ The deaths in recent days of two Black men in Tennessee, one in the custody of police and the other at the hands of national guard troops, has prompted the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People to demand the suspension of the so-called Memphis Safe Task Force , Donald Trump’s anti-crime alliance of federal, state and local law enforcement. In a letter to the acting attorney general, Todd Blanche, on Friday, the NAACP also demanded “a thorough, transparent federal investigation” into the actions of the taskforce, which it said has surged federal and military officers into Memphis with insufficient training for civilian policing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 倡导组织呼吁代理总检察长领导“彻底、透明的联邦调查”。最近几天，田纳西州两名黑人死亡，其中一名被警方拘留，另一名被国民警卫队杀害，这促使全国有色人种协进会要求暂停所谓的孟菲斯安全工作组，即唐纳德·特朗普的联邦、州和地方执法部门的反犯罪联盟。在周五写给代理总检察长托德·布兰奇的信中，全国有色人种协进会还要求对特别工作组的行为进行“彻底、透明的联邦调查”，称该工作组已将联邦和军官大量涌入孟菲斯，而这些人员的民警训练不足。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of tragic deaths and calls for accountability, the pursuit of justice becomes a vital expression of human dignity. Yahweh's desire is for justice to flow powerfully and consistently, ensuring that all are treated with fairness and their rights upheld.
reflection.zh: 面对悲剧性的死亡和对问责的呼吁，追求公义成为人类尊严的重要体现。雅伟渴望公义如大水般奔流不息，确保所有人都能得到公平对待，其权利得到维护。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Superb Sinner ends Djokovic's latest bid for history
title.zh: 出色的罪人终结了德约科维奇最近一次创造历史的努力

summary.en: Jannik Sinner produces a devastating display to end Novak Djokovic's latest bid for history and set up a Wimbledon final against Alexander Zverev.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Defending champion Jannik Sinner produced a devastating display to end Novak Djokovic's latest bid for a standalone record 25th Grand Slam title and reach the Wimbledon final against Alexander Zverev.

Just as he did at this stage last year, Sinner produced a display of power and precision to deny Djokovic in his pursuit of equalling Roger Federer's record eight men's singles titles at the All England Club.

Sinner did not offer a break point until midway through the third set but dismissed the 39-year-old Djokovic's only opportunity with an ace before going on to win 6-4 6-4 6-4.

World number one Sinner - the first Italian player to reach multiple Wimbledon men's singles finals - fittingly served out victory to love before embracing Djokovic at the net.

It was a 99th Grand Slam match win for four-time major winner Sinner, who will face Zverev in his seventh major final after the French Open champion ended British wildcard Arthur Fery's magnificent run .

"It's the most special tournament we have. It means a lot to me to play another final here," said Sinner.

"Of course, playing against Novak, he is a huge inspiration - not only for you guys but for the new generation - what he is still doing is amazing, incredible.

"We always have very, very tough matches. I'm very happy with this performance."

For Djokovic, cheered loudly as he exited the court, the wait to surpass Margaret Court and claim sole ownership of the all-time record for most Grand Slam singles titles won goes on.

Sinner is one win away from becoming the 10th man in the Open era to retain the Wimbledon title - and he will go into Sunday's final as the favourite after a statement performance.

After dispatching Djokovic, he will have every confidence that he possesses the weaponry and experience to overcome Zverev, who he has not lost to since 2023.

Sinner has not dropped a set since his opening match went the distance and produced his best tennis of the fortnight as he refused to offer Djokovic any way in to the match.

He continued his superb serving, landing a further 16 aces on Friday, and proved superior in both attack and defence, firing 40 winners to just 15 unforced errors.

Djokovic, understandably, was unable to rise to the heights that saw him beat Felix Auger-Aliassime in five sets after more than five hours and just minutes before the 11pm curfew on Wednesday.

The men's record 24-time major winner gave an appreciative wave to all sides of Centre Court as he took his leave, having been well-backed throughout a difficult afternoon.

In Sunday's final, Sinner will come up against an opponent who he has beaten in 10 of their 14 previous meetings - although he will be aware Zverev is a different proposition after ending his wait for a first major title at Roland...
body.zh: 卫冕冠军詹尼克·辛纳以毁灭性的表现结束了诺瓦克·德约科维奇最近一次对独立创纪录的第25个大满贯冠军的争夺，并进入温布尔登决赛对阵亚历山大·兹维列夫。 正如他去年在这个阶段所做的那样，辛纳展示了力量和精准，阻止了德约科维奇追平罗杰·费德勒在全英俱乐部创下的八个男单冠军纪录。 辛纳直到第三盘中段才提出破发点，但他以一记ace错失了39岁德约科维奇的唯一一次破发机会，最终以6-4 6-4 6-4获胜。 世界排名第一的辛纳是首位多次进入温布尔登男单决赛的意大利选手，他在网前拥抱德约科维奇之前，恰如其分地为爱人送上了胜利。 这是四届大满贯得主辛纳的第 99 场大满贯比赛胜利，在法网冠军结束了英国外卡选手阿瑟·费里的辉煌表现后，他将在他的第七场大满贯决赛中面对兹维列夫。 “这是我们举办的最特别的比赛。在这里再打一场决赛对我来说意义重大，”辛纳说。 “当然，与诺瓦克比赛，他是一个巨大的灵感 - 不仅对你们，而且对新一代 - 他仍在做的事情是惊人的，令人难以置信的。 “我们总是会遇到非常非常艰难的比赛。我对这次表演感到非常满意。” 对于德约科维奇来说，当他离开球场时，他大声欢呼，超越玛格丽特·考特并声称唯一拥有大满贯单打冠军最多的历史记录的等待仍在继续。 辛纳只差一场胜利就能成为公开赛时代第10位卫冕温布尔登冠军的人，在一场精彩的表演后，他将作为热门人进入周日的决赛。 在淘汰德约科维奇后，他将完全有信心拥有击败兹维列夫的武器和经验，自2023年以来，他从未输给过兹维列夫。 辛纳自从首场比赛打出了两周来最好的网球成绩以来，一直没有丢过一盘，因为他拒绝为德约科维奇提供任何进入比赛的机会。 他继续出色的发球，周五又打出 16 个 ace，在进攻和防守上证明了自己的优势，击出 40 个制胜分，只有 15 个非受迫性失误。 可以理解的是，在周三晚上 11 点宵禁前几分钟，德约科维奇在经过五个多小时零几分钟的比赛后，未能达到五盘击败菲利克斯·奥格·阿利亚西姆的高度。 这位男子24次大满贯赛冠军的纪录在离开时向中央球场的各方发出了赞赏的浪潮，因为在整个艰难的下午都得到了大力支持。 在周日的决赛中，辛纳将面对一个他在之前 14 次交锋中 10 次都击败过的对手——尽管他在结束对罗兰第一个大满贯冠军的等待后会意识到兹维列夫是一个不同的选择……

summary.en: A Ukrainian intelligence agent, who previously confessed to killing a woman suspected of an assassination attempt in Monaco, has now retracted his confession, claiming he did not commit the act.
summary.zh: 一名乌克兰情报人员此前承认杀害了一名涉嫌在摩纳哥刺杀一名千万富翁的女子，但现在他声称自己并未扣动扳机，撤回了之前的供词。

body.en:
Ukrainian intelligence agent Vladyslav Reut says he did not kill Anastasiia Berezovska - a woman suspected of trying to assassinate a multimillionaire in Monaco - despite earlier confessing to it.

Reut instead blamed his co-defendant Vitalii Zhykovych for the killing of Berezovska.

BBC correspondent Sarah Rainsford was in the courtroom in Kyiv when the claims were made and explains the latest developments. More on this story.
body.zh: 乌克兰情报特工弗拉迪斯拉夫·罗伊特表示，他并没有杀死阿纳斯塔西娅·别列佐夫斯卡（Anastasiia Berezovska）——一名涉嫌试图刺杀摩纳哥百万富翁的女性——尽管他早些时候承认了这一点。 相反，罗伊特指责他的同案被告维塔利·日科维奇杀害了别列佐夫斯卡。 BBC 记者莎拉·雷恩斯福德 (Sarah Rainsford) 提出索赔时正在基辅法庭，并解释了最新进展。更多关于这个故事的内容。

title.en: UK police arrest murder suspect in Ann Widdecombe's death
title.zh: 英国警方逮捕了造成安·维德科姆死亡的谋杀嫌疑人

summary.en: Police in southwest England say they have arrested a 26-year-old man on suspicion of murdering politician Ann Widdecombe. Based on initial inquiries, they were not treating the case as terrorism or politically motivated.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 英格兰西南部警方称，他们逮捕了一名涉嫌谋杀政客安·维德科姆的 26 岁男子。根据初步调查，他们并未将此案视为恐怖主义或出于政治动机。 英格兰西南部警方周五宣布，当局逮捕了一名涉嫌谋杀安·维德科姆的男子，此前几小时，这位曾经著名的政治家被发现死亡的消息传出。 维德科姆是 20 世纪 90 年代的保守党政府部长，以尖刻的言辞而闻名，她在政治生涯后期成为右翼民粹主义者奈杰尔·法拉奇 (Nigel Farage) 的盟友。 警方最初没有透露这起案件的潜在动机或背景。 “我们的谋杀案调查还处于早期阶段，但进展很快，”侦探总督察伊洛娜·罗森 (Ilona Rosson) 说。 “我们正在部署所有必要的资源，以查明到底发生了什么，并找到我们认为是白人男性的责任人。” 但在最初宣布这一消息后不久，警方表示，一名 26 岁的英国白人男性已被捕并仍被拘留。 德文郡和康沃尔郡警方的马特·朗曼表示，至少根据初步调查，该事件“并未被视为恐怖主义”或出于政治动机。 警方表示，周四中午，他们接到电话前往维德科姆位于德文郡达特穆尔的地址，发现她因“受重伤”而死亡。 罗森呼吁任何有信息的人挺身而出，“无论信息看起来多么微不足道”。 罗森说：“我们特别渴望收到任何可能在 Haytor Vale、Haytor 附近看到任何可疑物体的人的消息，或者任何拥有闭路电视、门铃或行车记录仪录像的人的消息，这可以帮助我们进行调查。” 英国首相基尔·斯塔默在这一“令人震惊的消息”中向维德科姆的家人和朋友表示哀悼，并称赞维德科姆是一位“杰出的”政治家。 斯塔默在嫌疑人被捕的消息传出前不久表示：“我认为这非常重要，因为在这个时刻我们要超越任何政治分歧、政治分歧。”他表示，首要任务是查明并确保一名“明显危险”的男子的安全。 斯塔默表示，他已与议长、保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺克、改革英国的奈杰尔·法拉奇和他的继承人安迪·伯纳姆进行了交谈，“敦促大家在这样的时刻团结起来，敦促大家帮助警方。” 维德科姆现年 78 岁，1987 年至 2010 年间担任前政府部长和保守党议员，并于 20 世纪 90 年代在约翰·梅杰 (John Major) 的英国政府中担任部长职务。 维德科姆担任...

title.en: Chip giant SK Hynix raises $26.5bn as shares surge in bumper US listing
title.zh: 芯片巨头 SK 海力士在美上市大获成功，股价飙升 265 亿美元

summary.en: The shares surged as much as 17% in their Nasdaq trading debut on Friday following the record-breaking foreign listing.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
South Korean computer chip maker SK Hynix has raised $26.5bn (£19.8bn) in its New York share offering, marking the largest ever listing by a foreign firm in the US.

The company, a key supplier to AI chip giant Nvidia, said on Thursday it had sold 177.9 million American depositary shares for $149 each. The shares surged as much as 17% on Friday in their first day of trading on the Nasdaq.

SK Hynix saw its market value top $1tn in its home country in May, lifted by the boom in demand for AI chips.

Its share price has more than tripled in South Korea this year, which along with Samsung Electronics has helped boost the benchmark Kospi index by more than 70% over the same period.

SK Hynix is one of the world's leading memory chip makers. The industry has been given a major boost by the hundreds of billions being spent on AI.

Shares in rivals Samsung Electronics and Micron have more than doubled in recent months.

The debut comes after the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) said this week a global surge in AI infrastructure spending is actively shielding tech-heavy economies, including South Korea, from the growth-stifling effects of the war in the Middle East.

The US listing gives SK Hynix easier access to huge amounts of potential investment from the world's biggest economy, which has fewer barriers than South Korea, said Seoul National University finance professor Jaewon Choi.

Traders are closely watching the listing as a "yardstick to test the water" for whether investor enthusiasm for memory chip makers will continue, Choi said.

The AI boom has triggered a rush of companies raising money on the the stock market.

In June, GrokAI owner SpaceX became the world's biggest ever listing as it raised $85.7bn.

Meanwhile, AI developers Anthropic and OpenAI are preparing to go public, with valuations of more $1tn.

Demand for SK Hynix's offering was reportedly over seven times more than the number of shares available, highlighting the strong investor appetite for a key company in the AI supply chain.

The bumper appetite effectively means investors were so desperate to buy the shares that the company was able to charge a price 2.9% higher than its current stock price in Seoul, rather than offering a traditional discount.

Each American depositary share is equivalent to a tenth of a Seoul-traded common share, SK Hynix said.

The offering gives US investors a way to buy SK Hynix shares without having to trade via an overseas stock exchange.

The company has pledged major investments to develop South Korea's chip making and AI capabilities in the coming years.

"They're using the money they're raising from this US listing to help build more plants, to develop these high-end chips," Shanti Keleman, co-chief investment officer at Seven Investment...
body.zh: 韩国计算机芯片制造商 SK 海力士在纽约股票发行中筹集了 265 亿美元（198 亿英镑），这是外国公司在美国上市以来规模最大的一次。 该公司是人工智能芯片巨头英伟达的主要供应商，周四表示，已以每股 149 美元的价格出售了 1.779 亿股美国存托股票。周五，该股在纳斯达克上市首日飙升 17%。 受人工智能芯片需求旺盛的推动，SK 海力士 5 月份在本国的市值突破 1 万亿美元。 今年，该公司股价在韩国上涨了两倍多，与三星电子一起帮助基准 Kospi 指数同期上涨了 70% 以上。 SK 海力士是全球领先的存储芯片制造商之一。数千亿美元的人工智能投入极大地推动了该行业的发展。 近几个月来，竞争对手三星电子和美光科技的股价上涨了一倍多。 此前，国际货币基金组织（IMF）本周表示，全球人工智能基础设施支出激增，正在积极保护包括韩国在内的科技密集型经济体免受中东战争抑制增长的影响。 首尔国立大学金融学教授 Jaewon Choi 表示，在美国上市使 SK 海力士更容易获得来自世界最大经济体的巨额潜在投资，而韩国的障碍比韩国少。 Choi 表示，交易员正在密切关注此次上市，将其视为投资者对存储芯片制造商的热情是否会持续的“试水标准”。 人工智能的繁荣引发了众多公司在股市上筹集资金的热潮。 6 月，GrokAI 母公司 SpaceX 筹集了 857 亿美元资金，成为全球有史以来规模最大的上市公司。 与此同时，人工智能开发商 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正准备上市，估值超过 1 万亿美元。 据报道，对 SK 海力士发行股票的需求是现有股票数量的七倍多，这突显了投资者对人工智能供应链中一家关键公司的强烈兴趣。 旺盛的胃口实际上意味着投资者非常渴望购买这些股票，以至于该公司能够以比首尔当前股价高出 2.9% 的价格，而不是提供传统的折扣。 SK 海力士表示，每股美国存托股票相当于首尔交易的普通股的十分之一。 此次发行为美国投资者提供了一种购买 SK 海力士股票的方式，而无需通过海外证券交易所进行交易。 该公司已承诺在未来几年进行重大投资，发展韩国的芯片制造和人工智能能力。 七号投资公司联合首席投资官尚蒂·克勒曼表示：“他们利用在美国上市筹集的资金来帮助建造更多工厂，开发这些高端芯片。”

title.en: Man nearly sucked out of window mid-air on Ryanair plane, passengers say
title.zh: 乘客称瑞安航空飞机上一男子险些被吸出窗外

summary.en: Officials reported that a man was almost pulled out of a Ryanair plane window mid-flight, with his wife holding onto his legs for approximately five minutes to prevent him from being sucked out.
summary.zh: 官员称，一名男子在瑞安航空的飞机上险些被吸出窗外，他的妻子抓住了他的双腿约五分钟，阻止他被吸出机舱。

body.en:
A man was nearly sucked head-first out of a cabin window in mid-air on a Ryanair plane, passengers have said.

Tracking data shows the plane was in the air for about 10 minutes when it abruptly descended 9,000ft (2,700m), with passengers telling local media they heard "some kind of explosion".

A Greek hospital official said a 61-year-old Serbian national was being treated for friction burns. "His wife held onto his legs for around five minutes to stop him from being sucked out," Michalis Giannakos said.

In a statement, Ryanair said its Friday morning flight from the Greek city of Thessaloniki to Germany's Memmingen returned "shortly after take-off when a passenger window dislodged in flight".

"The aircraft landed normally and passengers returned to the terminal. One passenger requested and received medical assistance on the ground in Thessaloniki," the Irish budget airline said.

It added that "a replacement aircraft was arranged to bring passengers to Memmingen" several hours later.

Passengers have told local media the man was left hanging head first out of the window as far as his shoulders before other passengers managed to pull him back inside.

Those on board have also said the window was smashed by pieces of the jet's engine - although Ryanair has not commented on this.

"We immediately realised there had been a decompression. There were screams... for a moment I thought someone had accidentally opened the emergency door," Christina, a fellow passenger, told Radio Thessaloniki.

"The masks dropped and there was a strong smell. The head and shoulders of one passenger were outside the window. Fortunately, he hadn't taken off his seat belt."

Another passenger, Sofia, told Radio Thessaloniki: "When the oxygen masks dropped, we had no idea what was going to happen. We didn't know whether we would make it back. We were sitting at the back of the aircraft, and we realised there had been some kind of explosion.

"We thought the plane was going down. The decompression was extreme. It felt like we couldn't breathe. The man who was injured was bleeding and then lost consciousness several times, most likely because of the lack of oxygen and the shock," Sofia added.

Michalis Giannakos, president of the Panhellenic Federation of Public Hospital Employees, later said that a 61-year-old Serbian man was being treated in hospital with friction burns.

The aircraft - believed to have been an 18 year-old-plane - was operated by Ryanair's subsidiary Malta Air.

Thessaloniki airport's operator Fraport Greece said "the incident is currently under investigation by the Hellenic Air and Rail Safety Investigation Authority".

Fraport Greece added that it "is fully co-operating with all relevant stakeholders and has activated the established emergency response...

title.en: Trump signals support for Patriot production in Ukraine
title.zh: 特朗普表示支持乌克兰爱国者生产

summary.en: US President Donald Trump says he may let Ukraine produce Patriot air defense missiles. Analysts welcome the move as a sign of support for the country — but warn it could take years before production begins.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump says he may let Ukraine produce Patriot air defense missiles. Analysts welcome the move as a sign of support for the country — but warn it could take years before production begins.

NATO members agreed a comprehensive military aid package for Ukraine totaling €140 billion at their recent Ankara summit . In addition, after meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy , US President Donald Trump announced that he intends to grant Ukraine a license to produce Patriot air defense missiles on its own soil.

These missiles are crucial for defending the country against Russian ballistic attacks. It has been reported that Ukrainian Patriot missiles stockpiles are running low. Indeed, the Ukrainian Air Force was unable to shoot down a single Russian missile during the massive attack on July 6.

The US intends to share its Patriot technology with Ukraine and grant it the right to produce the air defense missiles, Trump said. He also said the US was willing to provide any necessary support.

Trump also said he wants to buy Ukrainian drones, marking a complete reversal in his attitude toward Ukraine's defense industry, which he had previously dismissed. Now, however, he praised the country's extensive drone manufacturing capabilities.

He called it "amazing" that Ukraine was still able to build drones "in a war situation." Ukrainian drone expertise is widely sought after, including in Europe, and numerous countries signed drone agreements with Ukraine at the recent Ankara summit.

Ukraine would be the third country in the world — after Japan and Germany — granted the right to produce Patriot missiles. Going from political declarations to the actual production stage, however, will take years, says military expert Oleh Katkov, editor-in-chief of Defense Express, a Ukrainian media and consulting company.

"That's really great, it's a historic moment," Katkov told DW. "But it's important to realize that a process like this doesn't take just a few days or weeks. Despite its industry, skills, and expertise, it took Japan two years from reaching the agreement to starting production. We are likely still only in the stage of the Ukrainian and US governments reaching a general political agreement."

He told DW a government-level agreement needs to be finalized before defense contractors begin cooperation. Only then, Katkov said, will it be possible to negotiate with the US companies that hold the rights to the Patriot missiles.

"PAC-3 missiles are manufactured by Lockheed Martin, and PAC-2 missiles are built by RTX (Raytheon)," Katkov explained. "These companies must first draw up contracts with Ukrainian firms and only then can we talk about starting production in Ukraine."

title.en: Vietnam's baby bonuses unlikely to stop the aging clock
title.zh: 越南的生育奖励不太可能阻止老龄化进程

summary.en: Vietnam has joined other Southeast Asian nations in implementing policies to increase its birth rate. However, experts suggest that the greater challenge lies in adapting economic and welfare systems to support an increasingly aging population.
summary.zh: 越南已加入东南亚国家提高出生率的行列，但专家表示，更大的挑战在于调整经济和福利系统以适应日益老龄化的人口。

body.en:
Vietnam has joined Southeast Asia's push to raise birth rates, but experts say the greater challenge lies in adapting economies and welfare systems to an aging population.

On July 1, Vietnam's first Population Law took effect, introducing a range of measures aimed at encouraging couples to have more children.  

Women in targeted groups will receive a minimum childbirth subsidy of about €66 ($75).

Female employees who give birth to a second child are now entitled to seven months of maternity leave, up from six, while paternity leave for fathers whose wives have a second child has doubled to 10 working days.

Subsidies for prenatal and newborn screening will initially be offered to targeted groups before expanding nationwide in January. Families with at least two biological children may also receive priority access to social housing.

The law follows Vietnam's decision last year to scrap its longstanding two-child policy. However, reversing demographic trends will not be easy. Vietnam's fertility rate dropped to a record low of 1.91 children per woman in 2024, well below the replacement level of around 2.1.

By 2050, the share of Vietnam's working-age population, those aged 15 to 64, is projected to fall from 68.6% to 63%. Meanwhile, the proportion of the population aged 65 and over is expected to rise from 8.4% to 21.2%, according to the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific.

A key concern is that Vietnam grows old before it becomes wealthy. GDP per capita reached about $5,000 last year, significantly lower than the levels achieved by Japan, South Korea and Singapore when they were at Vietnam's stage of societal aging.

"If countries age before becoming rich, economic growth may slow, while income inequality and pressure on healthcare and social support systems may increase," Bussarawan Teerawichitchainan, an associate professor of sociology and co-director of the Center for Family and Population Research at the National University of Singapore, told DW.

"This could have serious implications for well-being, especially among older adults with limited resources," she added.

Across Southeast Asia , falling fertility rates and longer life expectancy are reshaping societies, though at varying rates.

In Singapore, the number of people aged 60 and above surpassed those under 15 around 2010. Thailand reached the same point in the mid-2010s. Vietnam is projected to follow by around 2035, according to the UN.

A growing elderly population places additional strain on healthcare services and the state, which must cover pension payments and other forms of social support.

title.en: If the US-Iran war reignites, how badly could Australia be impacted?
title.zh: 如果美伊战争再次爆发，澳大利亚将受到多大影响？

summary.en: The news explores the potential consequences for Australia if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran breaks down, leading to a renewed intensification of fighting.
summary.zh: 这则新闻探讨了如果美国和伊朗之间的停火协议破裂，战火再次升级，可能对澳大利亚造成的影响。

body.en:
A recent escalation in fighting between the United States and Iran has once again raised the spectre of widespread economic pain.

Since late February, disruptions to shipping routes have led oil prices to skyrocket, triggering fears that a prolonged conflict could plunge much of the world into recession.

However, since an interim ceasefire was formalised with a memorandum of understanding in June, international oil prices have fallen back to pre-war levels.

For a time, it seemed as if economic fallout from the conflict could be more limited than initially feared.

Commonwealth Bank head of Australian economics Belinda Allen wrote in a 6 July research note that the impact of the war in Iran was "less severe than we originally expected".

Several days later, the bank's head of geoeconomics, Joe Capurso, said he too had expected oil prices to stay elevated for longer, but "they've come back down to pre-war levels very fast".

However, renewed fighting and statements made by political leaders in recent days have cast doubt on whether the ceasefire and easing of oil prices will hold.

On Wednesday, the US military launched fresh strikes on Iran, saying it was responding to Iranian attacks on commercial ships in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.

Declaring the ceasefire "over", US President Donald Trump said he would allow negotiations to continue , but added: "As far as I'm concerned, it's just a waste of time dealing with them".

Following that, Iran accused the US of violating the ceasefire deal and launched strikes on US military targets in the Gulf.

Jessica Genauer, an international conflict expert at the University of New South Wales, said the tit-for-tat strikes suggest the MoU the countries signed on 17 June would not lead to a permanent peace.

"I think what we're going to be looking at is a sort of a middle path," she told SBS News.

"I don't think that we're going to return to the full-scale war that we saw from the 28th of February until the 8th of April, but I also don't think that we're now on a path towards a really substantial peace that involves a more significant agreement between Iran and the US."

She said optimism in the markets following the agreement was "probably a little premature".

"I think that in Australia we're relatively resilient and robust, but we will start to see some costs and consequences from the fact that this war is not over."

She said that, given the current impasse between the two sides, the cycle of back-and-forth strikes is likely to continue.

"I could see that continuing for at least a number of months, if not longer," she said.

title.en: Body of slain Iranian supreme leader arrives at Shia shrine as crowds chant 'Kill Trump'
title.zh: 遇害伊朗最高领袖遗体抵达什叶派圣地，人群高呼“杀死特朗普”

summary.en: Following the death of a prominent Iranian leader, large crowds gathered at a Shia shrine, chanting calls for revenge against the US. This event raises concerns about potential renewed attacks between the US and Iran, which could further destabilize global shipping and the economy.
summary.zh: 一位伊朗重要领袖去世后，大批民众聚集在什叶派圣地，高呼对美国进行报复的口号。这一事件引发了人们对美伊之间可能再次发生袭击的担忧，这可能会进一步扰乱全球航运和经济。

body.en:
The funeral procession of Iran's slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has reached the country's holiest shrine for his burial as the crowd bore banners reading "We Will Kill Trump".

As a week of funeral events reached its culmination, Khamenei's son and successor, Mojtaba Khamenei, has not been seen in public view after the 28 February US-Israeli strike that killed his father, which started the current conflict in the Middle East.

Khamenei's body was carried by truck slowly through the crammed streets of Mashhad in northeastern Iran towards the gilt dome and minarets of the Shrine of Imam Reza, flanked by white-turbaned clerics. Black-clad mourners pressed in close behind, waving Iranian flags, photographs of the late Khamenei and red placards with revolutionary slogans.

A helicopter lifted his coffin the final short stretch with the truck unable to pass through the thick crowds. It then lay on a carpet as clerics stood praying behind.

Meanwhile hostilities with the United States have erupted again this week despite a truce, with Iran still controlling the vital Strait of Hormuz waterway and proclaiming its victory in having survived a months-long assault by its most powerful enemies, Israel and the US.

Iranian authorities are presenting Khamenei's burial and the huge crowds attending his funeral as evidence of the popularity of their theocratic state and its lasting ideological fire, nearly half a century after the 1979 Islamic revolution.

The whereabouts of Mojtaba Khamenei, proclaimed supreme leader by a clerical assembly in early March, a week after his father's death, has remained a mystery to Iranians.

He has not appeared in public since the US and Israel started the war with the strike that killed Ali Khamenei. While he has issued written statements, no image, video or voice recording of him has been issued.

Senior sources in Tehran have said he was injured in the strike and is recovering, but he has not yet been well enough to make public appearances. State security services are also trying to limit his exposure in the event of further attacks from the United States.

As crowds jostled in Mashhad awaiting Khamenei's funeral cortege, the crowd chanted slogans demanding revenge on US President Donald Trump for his killing.

“I swear by the blood of the supreme leader, Trump, we will kill you!” they shouted, with women holding up placards reading "Kill Trump".

The shrine's courtyard was a sea of mourners as dusk fell, their defiant chants of "Death to America" ringing out above the lyrical funeral laments and sorrowful string music broadcast by loudspeakers.

title.en: South Africa: Driven home by anti-migrant protests
title.zh: 南非：因反移民抗议活动被迫返乡

summary.en: Two women shared their experiences of being forced to leave South Africa and return to Zambia due to anti-migrant protests, having to restart their lives from nothing.
summary.zh: 两名妇女讲述了她们因南非的反移民抗议活动而被迫离开南非返回赞比亚，不得不从头开始重建生活的故事。

body.en:
Two women tell DW how anti-migrant protests upended their lives in South Africa, forcing them to return to Zambia and rebuild from scratch.

With her baby strapped to her back and carrying little more than the clothes she was wearing, Glenda Banda crossed back into Zambia amid growing anti-migrant sentiment in South Africa .

South Africa has been her home for a decade. It was where she found work, raised her family and hoped to build a better future. She told DW that within days, everything she had worked for was gone.

"I came with only the clothes on my body. I had no clothes to change into," Banda said, adding that the local mayor had sent young men to her home to ask the landlord to evict her and her family.

"The landlord was forced to put all our belongings outside and lock the house," Banda told DW. "We had to flee and leave everything behind."

Banda is among more than 100 Zambians who returned to their homeland after anti-migrant protests — some of which turned violent — called for migrants  to be sent back.

Bernadette Mwelwa tells a similar story. After living in South Africa for more than 20 years, she returned to Zambia having lost not only her livelihood but also the life she had built there.

"Even if you were a refugee or an asylum seeker , as long as you were a foreigner they didn't want us there," she said.

"I can't go back to South Africa because I lost a lot of things. The mayor took the keys to my salon," Mwelwa told DW. "I left my husband, who is Congolese, to look after our supermarket, but it was looted and everything is gone."

Nigeria, Mozambique and Ghana have all raised concerns about attacks on their citizens living in South Africa.

Nigeria  on Sunday denounced the deaths of two of its citizens in South Africa , warning that foreign nationals are being "unduly targeted" amid the anti-migrant protests. South Africa's main police watchdog said it had opened an investigation, Reuters reported.

Mozambique's government said five of its citizens were killed "as a direct consequence of the xenophobic attacks" that flared after a march against undocumented migrants in the South African town of Mossel Bay at the end of May. 

South African police ​said only two Mozambicans died after being assaulted following the march, and would not say if there was a link with anti-migrant sentiment, according to the news agency Associated Press. 

Ghana said last week one of its citizens was fatally wounded in a shooting during the anti-migrant demonstrations. South Africa said his killing was not related to the protests ​and accused Ghana of spreading misinformation .

body.zh: 两名妇女告诉德国之声，反移民抗议活动如何颠覆了她们在南非的生活，迫使她们返回赞比亚并从头开始重建。 格伦达·班达（Glenda Banda）背着孩子，除了身上穿的衣服外，几乎没有带任何东西，在南非反移民情绪日益高涨的情况下，她穿越回赞比亚。 十年来，南非一直是她的家。她在那里找到了工作，养育了家庭，并希望建立更美好的未来。她告诉德国之声，几天之内，她为之努力的一切都消失了。 班达说：“我只带着身上的衣服。我没有衣服可换。”她补充说，当地市长派了年轻人到她家，要求房东驱逐她和她的家人。 班达告诉德国之声：“房东被迫把我们所有的物品都放在外面，并锁上房子。” “我们不得不逃离并抛下一切。” 班达是在反移民抗议活动（其中一些抗议活动演变成暴力活动）要求遣返移民后返回祖国的 100 多名赞比亚人之一。 伯纳黛特·姆韦尔瓦 (Bernadette Mwelwa) 也讲述了类似的故事。在南非生活了20多年后，她回到赞比亚，不仅失去了生计，也失去了在那里建立的生活。 “即使你是难民或寻求庇护者，只要你是外国人，他们就不希望我们在那里，”她说。 姆韦尔瓦告诉德国之声：“我无法回到南非，因为我失去了很多东西。市长拿走了我沙龙的钥匙。” “我留下我的刚果人丈夫来照看我们的超市，但超市被洗劫一空，所有东西都消失了。” 尼日利亚、莫桑比克和加纳都对居住在南非的本国公民遭受袭击表示担忧。 尼日利亚周日谴责了两名尼日利亚公民在南非的死亡事件，并警告称，外国人在反移民抗议活动中成为“不当目标”。据路透社报道，南非主要警察监管机构表示已展开调查。 莫桑比克政府表示，五月底南非莫塞尔湾镇针对无证移民的游行后爆发的“仇外袭击直接导致”五名莫桑比克公民被杀。 据美联社报道，南非警方表示，只有两名莫桑比克人在游行后遭到袭击而死亡，并且不愿透露是否与反移民情绪有关。 加纳上周表示，一名公民在反移民示威期间的枪击事件中身亡。南非表示他的被杀与抗议活动无关​并指责加纳散布错误信息。 尽管许多移民仍留在南非，但在经历了数周的反移民情绪、威胁以及在一些地区……之后，数千人离开了南非。

reflection.en: The displacement of these women highlights the pain caused when communities reject those seeking a new home. Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat foreigners as native-born, loving them as ourselves, remembering our shared human vulnerability. This principle calls us to extend compassion and justice to all, regardless of their origin.
reflection.zh: 这些妇女的流离失所凸显了当社区排斥寻求新家园的人时所造成的痛苦。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，要善待寄居者如同本地人，爱他们如同爱自己，并记住我们共同的人性脆弱。这一原则呼吁我们对所有人，无论其出身如何，都施以怜悯和公义。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Iran strikes military sites in Gulf states after top negotiator's warning against US 'bullying'
title.zh: 伊朗在高级谈判代表警告美国“霸凌”后，袭击海湾国家的军事地点

summary.en: Iran launched attacks on military sites in Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain. These strikes occurred after recent US military actions against Iran's southern coastal and eastern provinces.
summary.zh: 在美军近期袭击了伊朗南部沿海和东部省份之后，伊朗对科威特、卡塔尔和巴林的军事地点发动了袭击。

body.en:
Iranian armed forces targeted United States military infrastructure in neighbouring Gulf states on Thursday following US strikes on Iran's southern coastal and eastern provinces, putting further strain on a three-week-old ceasefire agreement.

Iran was also preparing on Thursday to bury its slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei at the country's holiest shrine in Mashhad, in the northeast, the culmination of a week of mass funeral processions and rallies. Khamenei was killed in a US airstrike on the first day of the war on 28 February.

The US military said on Wednesday its latest strikes on Iran were aimed at keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after Iran targeted three tankers in the area.

The assault came hours after US President Donald Trump said he believed the interim ceasefire with Iran to be "over".

Iranian officials said the US attacks had killed 14 people and injured 78 across five provinces on 8 and 9 July, state media reported. The Fars news agency said one US strike had hit a rail bridge used for trade with Russia and China.

Several explosions were heard on Thursday morning in Iran's Bushehr province, the semi-official Mehr news agency reported. Bushehr is home to a Russian-built nuclear power plant.

Iran's army said in a statement released by state media that it had targeted US Patriot systems with drones in Kuwait, an early warning site in Qatar (satellite antenna) and a fuel storage facility of the US army in Bahrain.

Kuwait said its armed forces had engaged with a cruise missile, three ballistic missiles and 10 drones in its airspace, and that one person had been injured from falling shrapnel.

Qatar, which hosts the largest US military base in the region and has often mediated between Washington and its adversaries, including Tehran, called for a return to diplomacy.

In a phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Aragchi, Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al-Thani also condemned attacks targeting commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

While Iran has not claimed responsibility for the ship attacks, analysts say Tehran uses such actions to gain leverage in negotiations.

The Strait of Hormuz handled about a fifth of global oil supplies before the war erupted on 28 February with US and Israeli strikes against Iran.

Tehran has since taken effective control of the strait, allowing it to force a stalemate in its confrontation with the world's most powerful military.

title.en: Uranium, universities, and 'top-tier' security: Inside the new Albanese-Modi agreements
title.zh: 铀、大学和“顶级”安全：阿尔巴尼亚-莫迪新协议的内幕

summary.en: Rivals in cricket, but allies in defence. Here's what the two nations have committed to.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及合一、和好与弥合分歧。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A handshake and a smile sealed the deal between Australia and its "top-tier" security partner, as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and his Indian counterpart, Narendra Modi, pledged to strengthen ties across trade, education, defence, science and technology.

" While we are separated by an ocean, we are indeed the closest of friends," Albanese told reporters in Canberra during a joint press statement.

"Australia values India as a top-tier security partner, and the Declaration reflects our shared commitment to a peaceful, stable and prosperous Indo-Pacific region."

References to cricket embraced the common ground between the two nations, with Modi likening their partnership to a "long and intense test match".

However, underneath the sports metaphors was an undercurrent of concern around the Indo-Pacific's defence challenges, with one eye on the fallout of war in Iran and economic disruptions, and the other on China, just days after it conducted a missile test in the Pacific .

Central to the agreement is the vision of a stable, peaceful and prosperous Indo-Pacific.

To get there, Albanese and Modi both pledged to strengthen defence ties between the two nations.

While no new partnership was announced, the two leaders confirmed their commitment to existing defence pledges, the most recent being the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership established in 2020.

" We will boost strategic coordination, increase the complexity of our defence exercises and further build interoperability between our defence forces," Albanese said.

" We have endorsed a joint maritime security collaboration roadmap and agreed to a new Australia-India partnership on cyber, critical technologies and supply chains."

India and Australia have opened the door to greater aircraft deployment in each other's territories, and there will be more exchanges, education, and training between the defence personnel of each nation.

They will also increase information sharing on terrorist threats in the region, terrorist financing and online radicalisation.

The strengthening of defence ties comes just two days after China tested a nuclear-capable missile in the Pacific.

"There is no doubt that this is a provocative act by China which does destabilise the region," Albanese said at the time.

title.en: East Asia braces for destructive typhoon as landslides kill 15 in Philippines

summary.en: Heading for Taiwan and south-eastern China, the 1,000 km-wide Bavi is forecast to be one of the strongest storms in decades.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Landslides triggered by one of the strongest storms in decades have killed at least 15 people in the southern Philippines, as parts of East Asia brace themselves for the looming storm.

Typhoon Bavi, which spans 1,000km (620 miles) at its widest point – roughly the width of France - is sweeping across the Pacific towards Taiwan.

It is expected to dump rain on Taiwan's north and east, and on a chain of remote Japanese islands, before making landfall in south-eastern China on Saturday.

Dozens of flights have been cancelled while schools have suspended classes across the region. Supermarket shelves have been wiped clean as residents stock up on supplies ahead of the typhoon.

On the Philippine island of Mindanao, families have been buried overnight by landslides, and rescuers are still searching for those missing.

Moderate to heavy rains will continue to drench parts of the country throughout the weekend, officials say.

Taiwanese authorities have warned that Bavi could bring up to 1m (39 inches) of rainfall. Some 29,000 soldiers have been put on standby to help with relief efforts, according to the island's defence ministry.

Bavi is set to be the largest storm, by size, to hit the island since 1987, Taiwan's Central Weather Administration told Reuters.

Farmers across the region rushed to harvest or protect their crops while the weather held earlier on Friday, while fishermen made sure to secure their vessels tightly.

"Don't be fooled by the nice and calm weather now. A storm like this could be the most terrifying," 60-year-old fisherman Chen Ming-hui told Reuters.

Thousands of sandbags have been distributed to residents and shop-owners in flood-prone areas.

Across the strait, China has also warned of "significant impact" from the typhoon that could move northward after smashing into the south-eastern Fujian province.

"Bavi's large size and abundant energy mean its remnants and outer rainbands could move from Jiangsu and Anhui provinces toward the Bohai Sea region," said Ma Jun, director of China's Institute of Public and Environmental Affairs.

The northern provinces, which have "less experience" dealing with typhoons in comparison with the south, should "strengthen preparations", he warned.

In Japan, residents on the remote Sakishima Islands are also on high alert. Photographs shared online show some of them taping up windows and draping windproof nets across their homes and shops.

Various airlines have grounded flights in the region. Japan Airlines, for instance, has axed more than 100 flights for Friday and Saturday, disrupting travel for nearly 20,000 passengers.

All Nippon Airways, another Japanese carrier, has cancelled more than 160 flights through Sunday, also affecting about 20,000 people, according to Reuters.

title.en: China retrieves booster in reusable rocket breakthrough
title.zh: 中国在可重复使用火箭突破中回收助推器

summary.en: China has joined the small group of space powers that can now recover an orbital-class booster rocket. Developers of the landing method turned to a striking alternative to that used by existing players such as SpaceX.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
China has joined the small group of space powers that can now recover an orbital-class booster rocket. Developers of the landing method turned to a striking alternative to that used by existing players such as SpaceX.

China on Friday successfully recovered the booster of an orbital-class rocket for the first time, marking a major advance in its push to develop reusable launch systems.

The Long March 10B lifted off from the Hainan commercial space launch site in southern China at 12:15 p.m. on Friday and placed a satellite into its designated orbit, state media reported.

Around six minutes after the booster separated from the rocket's upper stage, it descended vertically toward an offshore platform and was captured by a net-based retrieval system.

Unlike the rockets used by US companies SpaceX and Blue Origin , which land autonomously on deployable legs, the Long March 10B uses four hooks to catch a net suspended above the sea platform.

China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology expert Chen Muye said the approach simplifies the rocket's onboard structure, reduces its weight and could increase payload capacity.

"It is also highly adaptable to landing-point deviations, as coordinated ​net systems can effectively expand the capture window," Muye told state media agency Xinhua.

China has spent nearly a decade developing reusable rocket technology as it seeks to cut launch costs and support its rapidly expanding commercial satellite networks.

Previous recovery attempts by private company LandSpace and the state-owned China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation failed during the final landing stage last year.

The Long March 10B is also part of the broader Long March 10 family that China is developing for planned crewed lunar missions before 2030. Data from Friday's flight could help validate technology for the country's lunar program.

Shares in several Chinese aerospace companies surged following the test, with China Spacesat and China Satellite Communications reaching their daily trading limits.

The Long March 10B can carry at least 16 metric tons into low-Earth orbit and has been compared to SpaceX's Falcon 9, which has a maximum payload of 22.8 metric tons.

SpaceX first landed a Falcon 9 booster following an orbital mission in December 2015. It now launches the rocket around 150 times a year, frequently reusing individual boosters dozens of times.

title.en: China lands reusable rocket for first time, state media says
title.zh: 中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，官方媒体报道

summary.en: China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time, according to state media. This achievement follows similar successful landings by US companies SpaceX and Blue Origin.
summary.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，中国首次成功实现可重复使用火箭着陆。此前，美国公司SpaceX和Blue Origin也曾成功实现类似的可重复使用火箭着陆。

body.en:
China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in a major breakthrough for the country's space programme, according to state media.

The China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation said the Long March 10B rocket lifted off from Hainan in southern China at 12:15 local time (04:15GMT) on Friday.

Around six minutes after separating from the rocket's upper stage, its booster returned to Earth vertically and was recovered on a floating platform.

It signals that China may be able to challenge America's dominance in reusable rockets after successful landings by Elon Musk's SpaceX and Blue Origin, which is owned by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

Rockets are typically considered expendable - their various segments being discarded and destroyed during ascent - which makes launching spacecraft expensive.

By reusing boosters - which are generally seen as the most valuable part of a rocket - the cost of satellite launches and space exploration can be significantly lowered.

In December 2015, SpaceX landed a reusable Falcon 9 rocket from an orbital flight for the first time, followed by Blue Origin's New Glenn in November 2025.

The Falcon 9 now launches about 150 times a year with boosters that are capable of being reused dozens of times.

China made its first attempt at reusable rocket recovery in February, with a Long March 10A rocket. It completed a controlled descent and splashed down next to a recovery platform.

The Long March 10B, which can carry a payload of at least 16 metric tons to low-Earth orbit, has been compared to SpaceX's Falcon 9.

But unlike the Falcon 9, the Long March 10B does not autonomously land on a ground pad or drone ship. Instead "landing hooks" on the rocket catch a net attached to a floating platform.

Shares in Chinese space firms jumped following the news, with China Spacesat and China Satellite Communications each rising by 10%, the daily limit allowed by the country's financial market regulations.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，这是中国太空计划的重大突破。 中国航天科技集团公司表示，长征十号乙运载火箭于当地时间周五中午 12 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 04 点 15 分）从中国南部的海南岛升空。 与火箭上级分离后大约六分钟，其助推器垂直返回地球，并在浮动平台上回收。 这标志着，在埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的SpaceX和亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)旗下的蓝色起源(Blue Origin)成功着陆后，中国可能能够挑战美国在可重复使用火箭方面的主导地位。 火箭通常被认为是消耗性的——它们的各个部分在上升过程中被丢弃和毁坏——这使得发射航天器变得昂贵。 通过重复使用助推器（通常被视为火箭最有价值的部分），可以显着降低卫星发射和太空探索的成本。 2015 年 12 月，SpaceX 首次将可重复使用的猎鹰 9 号火箭从轨道飞行中着陆，随后蓝色起源的新格伦火箭于 2025 年 11 月着陆。 目前，猎鹰 9 号火箭每年发射约 150 次，其助推器可重复使用数十次。 今年二月，中国首次尝试使用长征十号甲运载火箭进行可重复使用火箭回收。它完成了受控下降并溅落在回收平台旁边。 长征十号B可以将至少16吨的有效载荷运送到近地轨道，有人将其与SpaceX的猎鹰9号进行比较。 但与猎鹰 9 号不同的是，长征十号 B 不能自动降落在地面垫或无人机船上。相反，火箭上的“着陆钩”抓住了连接在浮动平台上的网。 消息传出后，中国航天公司的股价大幅上涨，中国航天和中国卫星通信股价均上涨 10%，这是中国金融市场法规允许的涨停板。

reflection.en: This technological milestone reflects humanity's persistent drive to explore and innovate, echoing the biblical observation that knowledge will increase. Such advancements remind us of the incredible capacity for discovery Yahweh has placed within us, inviting us to steward these gifts responsibly for the good of all.
reflection.zh: 这一技术里程碑反映了人类探索和创新的不懈动力，呼应了圣经中关于知识将不断增长的论述。此类进步提醒我们雅伟赋予人类的惊人发现能力，邀请我们负责任地管理这些恩赐，造福全人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: China: Dozens killed in shoe factory fire
title.zh: 中国：鞋厂火灾致数十人死亡

summary.en: Dozens of people were killed in a shoe factory fire in Jinjiang, China, with hundreds of rescue workers dispatched to the site. President Xi Jinping indicated that "heavy human losses" were anticipated.
summary.zh: 中国晋江一家鞋厂发生火灾，造成数十人死亡，数百名救援人员被派往现场。习近平主席表示预计将有“重大人员伤亡”。

body.en:
Hundreds of rescue workers were dispatched to the site in Jinjiang, China, where many had become trapped in a burning factory. President Xi Jinping said "heavy human losses" were expected.

At least 28 people were killed in a fire at a shoe factory in eastern China on Thursday.

China's Ministry of Emergency Management announced that some 200 fire and rescue workers had been dispatched to a shoe factory in Fujian province on Thursday.

President Xi Jinping has called for "an all-out search and rescue effort" and a swift investigation in order to "strictly hold those responsible accountable."

Dozens of fire trucks were seen dumping water on the burnt multi-story factory as smoke continued to billow from the site.

"Simultaneously, the cause of the fire must be investigated, lessons learned, and effective measures taken to prevent similar accidents from recurring," the ministry said in a statement.

Beijing launched a renewed campaign to bring high-rise buildings and factories in line with fire codes in November after 168 people were killed in Hong Kong where several tower blocks went up in flames.
body.zh: 数百名救援人员被派往中国晋江的现场，许多人被困在一座着火的工厂里。习近平主席表示，预计将造成“严重人员伤亡”。 周四，中国东部一家鞋厂发生火灾，造成至少 28 人死亡。 中国应急管理部周四宣布，已派出约200名消防救援人员前往福建省一家鞋厂。 习近平主席呼吁“全力搜救”，迅速展开调查，“严肃追究责任人的责任”。 人们看到数十辆消防车向被烧毁的多层工厂倾倒水，现场浓烟继续滚滚。 公安部在一份声明中表示：“同时，必须调查起火原因，吸取教训，并采取有效措施，防止类似事故再次发生。” 11 月，香港多座高楼起火，导致 168 人死亡，北京方面重新启动了一项行动，要求高层建筑和工厂遵守消防规范。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the factory fire brings immense sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of human existence. In moments of such profound grief, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear. This hope assures us that death, mourning, crying, and pain will ultimately cease.
reflection.zh: 这场工厂火灾中生命的悲惨逝去带来了巨大的悲伤，也提醒我们人类生命的脆弱。在如此深重的悲痛时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去我们所有眼泪的应许。这个盼望向我们保证，死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛终将止息。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Venomous snakes escape breeding farms in southern China during flooding
title.zh: 中国南方洪灾中，毒蛇从养殖场逃逸

summary.en: Hundreds of snakes, including king ratsnakes and cobras, have escaped from flooded breeding farms in southern China. This incident occurred as severe storms, including typhoon Maysak, caused widespread flooding in the region.
summary.zh: 中国南方多地遭受严重风暴袭击，台风“美莎克”引发洪水，导致数百条蛇，包括王锦蛇和眼镜蛇，从被淹的养殖场逃逸。

body.en: Local media in Hengzhou report king ratsnakes and cobras among hundreds in flood waters caused by typhoon Maysak Hundreds of snakes, including cobras, have escaped from flooded breeding farms in southern China as severe storms continue to batter parts of the country. State media reported that a snake farm in Hengzhou, in Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, was hit by flood waters after days of heavy rainfall caused by typhoon Maysak , prompting warnings for nearby residents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 衡州当地媒体报道称，台风“美莎克”引发的洪水中，有数百条蛇王和眼镜蛇。随着严重风暴继续袭击中国部分地区，包括眼镜蛇在内的数百条蛇从中国南部被洪水淹没的养殖场中逃出。官方媒体报道称，台风“美莎”连日来带来强降雨，广西壮族自治区横州的一个养蛇场遭到洪水袭击，附近居民收到警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The escape of venomous snakes during severe flooding reminds us of creation's vulnerability when faced with powerful natural forces. Romans 8:22 speaks to how the whole creation groans under the weight of disruption, a reality keenly felt when disasters lead to unexpected dangers. In such times, we are called to care for both human safety and the wider...
reflection.zh: 毒蛇在严重洪水中逃逸，提醒我们面对强大自然力量时，受造界的脆弱性。罗马书8:22提到整个受造界都在劳苦叹息，当灾难带来意想不到的危险时，这种感受尤为强烈。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召要关顾人类安全和更广阔的自然界，信靠雅伟最终的掌权。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Typhoon, tornadoes, landslides: deadly weather ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 台风、龙卷风、山体滑坡：致命天气肆虐中国（图）

summary.en: Typhoon Maysak and severe storms, including tornadoes and landslides, have caused widespread devastation across China, resulting in at least 15 fatalities in Guangxi and Hubei provinces.
summary.zh: 台风“美莎克”和包括龙卷风、山体滑坡在内的严重风暴在中国各地造成了广泛破坏，导致广西和湖北省至少15人死亡。

reflection.en: In the face of devastating natural disasters like typhoons and tornadoes, human vulnerability is starkly revealed. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos and loss, we can find solace in the enduring presence of the Divine.
reflection.zh: 面对台风和龙卷风等毁灭性的自然灾害，人类的脆弱性显露无遗。诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱和损失之中，我们也能在神永恒的同在中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: German car industry warns of job collapse unless ‘bold decisions’ made to address Chinese threat
title.zh: 德国汽车工业警告：若不“大胆决策”应对中国威胁，就业岗位恐将崩溃

summary.en: The German car industry has warned of a potential collapse of employment in Europe unless "bold decisions" are made to address the threat from Chinese competition. Volkswagen is reportedly preparing to propose 100,000 job losses and consider foreign ownership of car plants to save jobs.
summary.zh: 德国汽车工业警告称，除非做出“大胆决策”以应对来自中国的威胁，否则欧洲该行业的就业岗位可能面临崩溃。据报道，大众汽车正准备提议裁员10万人，并考虑将汽车工厂置于外国所有权之下以保住工作岗位。

body.en: VW to propose 100,000 job losses to board and says car plants could be put under foreign ownership to save jobs Europe live – latest updates The German car industry has warned of a potential collapse of employment in the sector in Europe unless society and workers accept that “bold decisions” are needed to address competition from the Chinese and other rivals. Volkswagen is preparing to formally propose up to 100,000 job losses , a move that has triggered a wave of protests. Continue reading...

In moments of such profound uncertainty and complex choices, leaders and communities are called to seek wisdom beyond conventional understanding. Yahweh promises to generously provide wisdom to those who ask, guiding them through...
reflection.zh: 德国汽车工业面临巨大压力，需要“大胆决策”以避免失业并适应全球变化。在如此深刻的不确定性和复杂选择的时刻，领导者和社区被呼召寻求超越传统理解的智慧。雅伟应许慷慨地赐予那些求问祂的人智慧，以清晰和洞察力引导他们度过艰难的转型。

verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: How do Australia's 'great deals' with its neighbours compare to China?
title.zh: 澳大利亚与邻国的“大交易”与中国相比如何？

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is strengthening diplomatic and economic ties with Pacific island nations, a region where China has significant influence.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯正在加强与太平洋岛国的外交和经济关系，该地区是中国具有重要影响力的区域。

body.en:
Anthony Albanese is turning his attention to the Solomon Islands after securing Australia a major new defence agreement with Fiji, as he seeks to shore up support against the expansion of Chinese influence in the region.

Albanese and Fijian Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka formalised the Ocean of Peace Alliance alongside an updated Vuvale Union partnership during a ceremony in the Fijian capital Suva on Monday.

Albanese hailed the treaties, aimed at strengthening regional security amid intensifying strategic competition in the Pacific, as "one of the most significant endeavours Australia has undertaken with any country".

Fiji is one of Australia's closest Pacific security partners and has one of the region's largest militaries, making the agreement one of Canberra's most noteworthy in the Pacific.

The visit to Suva is part of a days-long diplomatic mission during which Albanese will meet with several regional leaders including Solomon Islands counterpart Matthew Wale for a whistle-stop tour on Tuesday, with the focus on a new comprehensive treaty.

The leaders last week agreed to start talks on a treaty to "capture the two countries' joint ambition for the relationship".

This latest push from Albanese comes as China confirmed on Monday it successfully tested a submarine-launched ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

The agreements with Fiji expand the two nations' long-standing security and development relationship and introduce a mutual defence commitment.

The new Ocean of Peace Alliance commits both countries to consult and respond to security developments that threaten the sovereignty, peace or stability of either nation.

"Each Party recognises that an armed attack on any of the Parties within the Pacific would be dangerous to each other's peace and security as well as the security of the Pacific, and declares that it would act to meet the common danger, in accordance with its domestic processes," the deal reads.

Australia will support the partnership with more than $1 billion in funding over the next decade, targeting transnational crime prevention and investing in education, healthcare, and infrastructure projects in Fiji.

Australia works with all 14 Pacific Island nations to varying degrees, and has major security agreements with Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu, Tuvalu and Nauru.

It also cooperates with other nations in the region, from foreign aid and infrastructure funding to marine surveillance and peacekeeping.

Henry Ivarature, a Pacific fellow with the Australia Pacific Security College at the Australian...
body.zh: 在澳大利亚与斐济达成一项重要的新防务协议后，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞将注意力转向所罗门群岛，寻求支持反对中国在该地区扩张的影响力。 阿尔巴尼亚和斐济总理西蒂维尼·拉布卡周一在斐济首都苏瓦举行的仪式上正式成立了和平海洋联盟，并更新了武瓦莱联盟伙伴关系。 阿尔巴尼斯称赞这些旨在在太平洋地区战略竞争加剧的情况下加强地区安全的条约是“澳大利亚与任何国家所做的最重要的努力之一”。 斐济是澳大利亚最亲密的太平洋安全伙伴之一，并拥有该地区最大的军队之一，这使得该协议成为堪培拉在太平洋地区最值得关注的协议之一。 对苏瓦的访问是为期几天的外交访问的一部分，在此期间，阿尔巴内斯将于周二与包括所罗门群岛同行马修·韦尔在内的几位地区领导人进行短暂停留，重点讨论一项新的全面条约。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 两国领导人上周同意开始就一项条约进行谈判，以“体现两国对两国关系的共同抱负”。 阿尔巴尼斯提出这一最新举措之际，中国周一证实在太平洋国际水域成功试射了一艘战略核潜艇携带的潜射弹道导弹。 与斐济的协议扩大了两国长期的安全和发展关系，并引入了共同防御承诺。 新的和平海洋联盟要求两国就威胁两国主权、和平或稳定的安全事态发展进行磋商和做出反应。 协议中写道：“各方认识到，对太平洋地区任何一方的武装攻击将危及彼此的和平与安全以及太平洋地区的安全，并宣布将根据其国内程序采取行动应对共同危险。” 澳大利亚将在未来十年内提供超过 10 亿美元的资金支持这一伙伴关系，旨在预防跨国犯罪，并投资于斐济的教育、医疗保健和基础设施项目。 澳大利亚与所有 14 个太平洋岛国都有不同程度的合作，并与巴布亚新几内亚、斐济、所罗门群岛、瓦努阿图、图瓦卢和瑙鲁签署了重大安全协议。 它还与该地区其他国家合作，从对外援助和基础设施资金到海洋监视和维和。 亨利·伊瓦拉图（Henry Ivarature）是澳大利亚太平洋安全学院的太平洋研究员。

reflection.en: International relations often involve complex strategies and the pursuit of national interests. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that wise counsel is essential for a nation's stability and security. As leaders navigate intricate global dynamics, seeking diverse and sound advice can safeguard against missteps and foster a more secure future.
reflection.zh: 国际关系常涉及复杂的策略和国家利益的追求。箴言11:14提醒我们，智慧的谋略对国家的稳定和安全至关重要。当领袖们驾驭错综复杂的全球动态时，寻求多元而稳妥的建议能避免失误，并促进一个更安全的未来。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: 'Destabilising': Australia criticises China after ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific
title.zh: “破坏稳定”：澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验

summary.en: Australia has criticized China following a ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific, describing the action as "destabilising." This test marks China's latest intercontinental ballistic missile launch in 2024.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋地区进行弹道导弹试射，称此举“破坏稳定”。这是中国在2024年进行的最新一次洲际弹道导弹试验。

body.en:
Australia and New Zealand have sounded the alarm after China confirmed it successfully tested a ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

Chinese state media Xinhua reported that the testing is part of China's annual military exercise, and it had alerted relevant countries in advance, in accordance with international law.

Xinhua described the launch as a "routine arrangement" of China's annual military training and said it was not directed against any specific country or target.

This comes after Australia and Fiji signed a major defence alliance earlier in the day, committing each country to come to the other's aid in case either is attacked.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Australian government had been advised in advance by China of the test.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Australia has been clear with China that we regard this as destabilising to the region," she told reporters on Monday, moments before the launch was confirmed.

"This proposed test is in the context of a rapid military buildup by China, which is lacking in the transparency and reassurance as to intent that the region expects."

Wong said the test was "inconsistent" with Pacific leaders' requests for the ocean to be one "of peace".

"It appears that, despite our long-standing concerns about this type of activity, China carried out the test within hours of informing us," he said in a statement.

"The Pacific is an Ocean of Peace and we are deeply concerned by China's testing of nuclear-capable weapons into the South Pacific."

Japan's government said it had been notified of the missile launch and urged China to reconsider.

"We expressed our grave concern over the Chinese military's increased activity," Tokyo said, adding that Japan's Coast Guard had been notified on Sunday by Chinese authorities about falling space debris that could fall within Japan's exclusive economic zone.

Japan's Kyodo news agency on Monday reported, citing a Japanese government source, that the missile had landed outside Japan's EEZ.

Even if you weren’t a Telstra customer, you were likely affected by its network outage on Wednesday , as its share price fell in the aftermath.

However, sharemarkets were more impacted by the renewed hostilities in the Middle East which caused a spike in oil prices and will likely lead to higher petrol prices in a few weeks.

On a positive note, the Australian sharemarket welcomed its newest company in what was a successful listing.

And one of our biggest banks is now expecting interest rates to fall earlier than expected, albeit with a condition: they need to rise first.

Australian drivers are beginning to feel the impact of the government's decision to reduce the temporary fuel excise discount .

The national average price of unleaded petrol rose by 3.2 cents a litre during last week to just under $1.63 a litre.

While prices increased, the rise was far smaller than the 16 cents a litre experts feared after the fuel excise discount was halved.

Lower global oil prices initially negated the impact, but the renewed conflict in the Middle East this week saw Brent crude rise again, approaching US$80 ($115) a barrel.

This increases the likelihood that fuel prices could jump in the coming weeks, despite higher fuel shipments in June this year compared with June 2025.

Westpac now expects the first RBA rate cut to come in 2027 instead of 2028, bringing it into line with the other major banks.

However, chief economist Luci Ellis still believes the Reserve Bank will need to lift interest rates twice before then because inflation risks remain.

The former RBA assistant governor says inflation was high before the war, and while some businesses are passing on higher fuel costs, other factors are contributing to it like stronger prices for electronics because of AI demand.

For borrowers, it means mortgage rate uncertainty is unlikely to disappear any time soon.

While Telstra customers and businesses were disrupted by the network outage on Wednesday , its shareholders also took a hit.

The company is one of Australia’s most widely held stocks, with many investors likely to have a direct stake following its first float in 1997, while others would have exposure through their super funds.

Construction company FDC Consolidated became Australia's biggest IPO of the year after raising $400 million.

Its shares surged 17 per cent on debut on Thursday before closing more than 12 per cent above the offer price on day one and adding another 3 per cent on day two.

summary.en: NT Police have publicly released Bradley John Murdoch's final interviews, revealing two unsuccessful attempts to persuade him to disclose the location of Peter Falconio's remains.

body.en:
The Northern Territory Police Force has provided SBS News with never-before-seen video of Bradley John Murdoch being interviewed less than three weeks before he died.

In the interview, officers made a last-ditch attempt to have Murdoch reveal information about Peter Falconio’s whereabouts.

Murdoch was convicted of fatally shooting British backpacker Peter Falconio near the remote Central Australian town of Barrow Creek in 2001.

Murdoch never revealed the location of the 28-year-old’s body and has always maintained his innocence.

He was also convicted of assaulting and attempting to kidnap Falconio's girlfriend, Joanne Lees, who managed to escape into bushland.

On 25 June 2025 two police officers visited the 66-year-old in the Alice Springs Correctional Centre.

“I know nothing, know nothing. I've said this for 22 years I know nothing. I know that. You keep asking these questions. I know nothing,” Murdoch said.

Officers attempted to pass on a message from Falconio’s family with the help of police in the United Kingdom but Murdoch refused to view it.

“I need you to have a think about if Peter Falconio was your son Quinton, and somebody knew something about where his body was,” said one of the police officers.

“I thought about it for 22 f----ing years. I've been with these fellas for 22 years. They've all understood what's going on. I've said the same story over and over and over. And now you're here at the last minute because I'm f----ing dying. No one gives a f--k about me. Well, some people do, but ...

“I don't have information. This is what I'm trying to say to you. I don't have this information. Stop saying this.”

A week later, police visited Murdoch again in palliative care, but a coronial inquest was told that visit lasted just 30 seconds.

And then on 16 July 2025, Murdoch died, following his battle from stage-four cancer.

NT Police have also released new photos from the case, just days before the 25 th anniversary since Falconio went missing in the NT’s outback on 14 July 2001.

The fresh images show a footprint in the red sand, bullet — including a marking on the backpacker’s orange combi van as well as the injuries Joanne Lees after she escaped.

Falconio and Lees were travelling along Stuart highway when Murdoch drove up behind them and indicated they should pull over, saying their van might have an engine problem.

Falconio went behind the car with him to investigate and Lees heard a gunshot. Murdoch then cable-tied her and covered Lees' head.

title.en: First home buyers at Sydney auctions hope the market might be a little less ‘untouchable’ at last

summary.en: Dreams of home ownership feel closer for some as property prices cool across Australia’s capital cities On a crisp winter Saturday morning, newlywed couple Ruban Parajuli and Arya Katel stand among more than 60 prospective buyers at a house auction in Sydney’s inner-west suburb...
